text:
900kJ of energy is transferred to a mass of water. The temperature of the water increases from
20°C to 45°C.
The specific heat capacity of water is 4200J/(kg°C).
Which mass of water is heated?
A
0.0086kg
B
5.4kg
C
8.6kg
D
11kg
subject: Physics
